title: 第7章 无缘祝余第8章 前尘往事
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
检测完所有人后，检测师向几人走了过来，拿出两枚玉牌递给楚清瑶和楚青鱼，玉牌的正面刻着祝余学院四个大字，背面则刻着两人的姓名籍贯。
“这是祝余学院的入学身份令牌，两位凭此令牌可以免费入学读书，请在七日内到书院报到，逾期将会取消入学资格。”
楚清瑶接过令牌，眉头微皱，“我哥哥的令牌呢，他的无垢狐能成长到三阶，按理说也有资格入学的。”
按往年的经验确实是如此，像青乌镇这样偏远的小镇，能检测出两个能成长为三阶的灵主已是不易，有些时候甚至连一个能达到条件的人都没有。
谁能想到今年镇上竟然出了四个满足条件的孩子，甚至其中两个未来还能成为中级灵主。
可惜，祝余学院给青乌镇的入学名额只有两个，因此资质相对差不少的楚少野和王泽凯便被淘汰了。
楚少野的无垢狐品阶低不说，战力也说不上强，完全无法跟楚清瑶的霓裳鸾鸟和楚青鱼的翡翠竹叶青相比。
检测师将缘由解释了一遍，楚清瑶听完直接将玉牌放回了检测师手中，“既然哥哥没机会去上学，那我也不去了。”
楚青鱼见她这么做，略一犹豫，将自己的玉牌也塞了回去，“那，那我也不去了。”
自从楚青鱼的父亲去世，村长一家不知道帮了她们母女多少忙，楚望山就不说了，每次都是他将柳倩做的绣活捎带到镇上的店铺卖，楚少野打来猎物也经常分给她们，娘俩才不至于饿死。
楚青鱼抿了抿唇，下定了决心，对检测师坚定道：“我不去了，把名额给楚大哥，让瑶瑶和楚大哥一起去上学吧。”
检测师拿着玉牌，无奈地摇了摇头，这还是他第一次碰到有人上赶着放弃入学机会的，要是资质一般的孩子也就算了，楚清瑶和楚青鱼资质都很不错，如果不去上学的话，实在太过可惜。
楚少野没想到两个女孩子会这么做，当即站了出来，他先是对楚清瑶说了声胡闹，然后对着检测师行了一礼。
“家妹不懂事，还请灵主大人见谅，瑶瑶和青鱼都会按时去学校报到的。”
楚清瑶还想说什么，楚少野瞪了她一眼，神色很是不虞，他向来是个温和好脾气的哥哥，偶尔发一次怒，威慑力比楚望山还要强。
楚清瑶不敢再说什么，只好瘪了瘪嘴将话咽了回去。
检测师见问题解决，对这个少年更加赞赏，他将身份玉牌重新递还给了楚清瑶和楚青鱼两人，看着楚少野满意地点了点头。
丧失祝余学院入学资格还能坦然处之，冷静理智，未生嫉妒，确实是可造之材。
检测师道：“虽然不能破例给你祝余学院的入学名额，但是我在赤霄宗有些关系，可以给你写一封介绍信让你在赤霄宗做个杂役弟子，你可愿去？”
赤霄宗是与祝余城相邻的一个势力，两者实力相当，就算是杂役弟子，想要加入也不是那么简单的。

楚少野没想到事情竟然还有转机，略愣神后，便立刻答应了下来。
楚清瑶和楚青鱼虽然没有听说过赤霄宗，但是既然是检测师推荐的，自然也是个好去处，一扫失落的心情，转而为楚少野高兴起来。
这下哥楚大哥也有去处了。
镇长让人取来纸笔，检验师当即上写了一封推荐信，印上自己的私印后交给了楚少野。
楚少野双手接过，珍重地将信放入怀里。
楚望山很是激动，他不会说客套话，只一个劲的对检验师表达感谢。
检验师摆摆手，他做这些也不是全无私心，除了欣赏楚少野之外，以楚清瑶和楚青鱼的资质，只要不半路夭折，未来必有所成就，他这也是提前结个善缘。
镇长想要请检测师还有楚家村的几人用晚宴，但是检测师急着回灵主协会复命，便婉拒了。
临走前检测师道：“今年青乌镇孩子们的总体资质不错，尤其是楚家村，我回去后会向祝余学院说明情况，看看以后能不能多给青乌镇几个名额。”
镇长大喜过望，没想到还会有这种好事，急忙对检测师再三道谢。
送走了检测师，楚望山也婉拒了镇长的邀请，“我还得带孩子们回村，家长们都等着呢，回去晚了怕他们担心。”
他虽然老实，但也是做了多年村长的人，并不傻，知道镇长这么殷勤是为了什么，“镇长你放心，我家的孩子和青鱼都是好孩子，不会忘本的。”
有了他这句话，镇长宽心不少，亲自送楚家村的人离开镇子。
告别镇长，楚望山带着孩子们坐上牛车，他们村只有楚少野他们三个有灵主资质，其他的孩子在对比下难免有些闷闷不乐。
楚望山呵呵笑了一声，安慰道，“这世上有千千万万人，谁都能成灵主吗，你们看村长我，虽然有大黄，但是大黄平时就是帮我犁犁地，拉拉车，日子过的和村里的大家没什么两样。”
“各人有各人的缘法，你们爹娘都在家等着呢，我们做爹娘的不求孩子能多有出息，只要你们健康快乐就好了。”
楚望山从怀里掏出一个油纸包，递给楚清瑶，“瑶瑶，去给大家分一分，每人一块。”
这是他刚才抽空去小吃摊上买的白云糕，都还是小孩子嘛，吃点好吃的就哄好了。
楚清瑶打开油纸包，里面正好是八块，给大家一人发了一块，她和楚少野也有。
白云糕是用白芸豆作为主料制成，白芸豆蒸熟后，用纱布过滤掉豆皮，过滤出的豆蓉加上适量的蜂蜜搅和成团，然后放到模具里压制成型，表面点缀上白芝麻就做好了。

白云糕松软香甜，入口即化，村里的孩子们轻易吃不到这么精致的糕点，小心翼翼地用手捧着，一小口一小口地吃，生怕浪费了。
小孩子的情绪来的快去的也快，吃完糕点后心情便好了不少，脸上也有了笑模样，对着三人道恭喜。
楚家村一下子出了三个灵主，他们身为同村人也与有荣焉，以后他们楚家村可就了不得了，别的村不得羡慕死他们。

content_en:
After testing everyone, the inspector walked over to several people and took out two jade plaques and handed them to Chu Qingyao and Chu Qingyu. The four characters of Zhu Yu Academy were engraved on the front of the jade plaque, and their names and birthplaces were engraved on the back.
"This is the admission status token of Zhu Yu College. With this token, you two can enroll in school for free. Please report to the college within seven days. If you exceed the deadline, your admission qualification will be cancelled."
Chu Qingyao took the token and frowned slightly, "Where's my brother's token? His Wugou Fox can grow to the third level, so it stands to reason that he is also eligible for admission."
This is true based on previous years' experience. In a remote town like Qingwu Town, it is not easy to detect two spirit masters who can grow into the third level. Sometimes there is not even one person who can meet the conditions.
Who would have thought that this year there would be four children who met the conditions in the town, and two of them would even become intermediate spiritual masters in the future.
Unfortunately, Zhu Yu College only had two admission quotas for Qingwu Town, so Chu Shaoye and Wang Zekai, who had relatively poor qualifications, were eliminated.
Not only was Chu Shaoye's Wugou Fox low-level, but its combat power was not strong either. It was completely incomparable to Chu Qingyao's Neon Luan Bird and Chu Qingyu's Jade Bamboo Leaf Green.
The inspector explained the reason. After hearing this, Chu Qingyao directly put the jade plaque back into the inspector's hand, "Since my brother has no chance to go to school, I won't go either."
When Chu Qingyu saw her doing this, he hesitated for a moment and stuffed his jade token back, "Then, I won't go either."
Ever since Chu Qingyu's father passed away, the village chief and his family had helped their mother and daughter countless times. Chu Wangshan wouldn't go into details. He always brought the embroidery work made by Liu Qian to the shops in the town to sell it. Chu Shaoye often shared the prey he brought with them, so that the two of them would not starve to death.
Chu Qingyu pursed her lips, made up her mind, and said firmly to the inspector: "I won't go, give the place to Brother Chu, and let Yaoyao and Brother Chu go to school together."
The inspector held the jade sign and shook his head helplessly. This was the first time he encountered someone who gave up the opportunity to go to school. Forget it if they were children with average qualifications. Chu Qingyao and Chu Qingyu had very good qualifications. It would be a pity if they did not go to school.
Chu Shaoye didn't expect the two girls to do this, so he stood up immediately. He first said "Nonsense" to Chu Qingyao, and then saluted the inspector.
"My sister is not sensible. Please forgive me, Lord Spiritual Master. Yaoyao and Qingyu will both report to school on time."
Chu Qingyao wanted to say something else, but Chu Shaoye glared at her with a very worried expression. He had always been a gentle and good-tempered brother, and once he got angry occasionally, his deterrence was even stronger than Chu Wangshan's.
Chu Qingyao didn't dare to say anything more, so she swallowed the words with her mouth closed.
When the inspector saw that the problem was solved, he appreciated the young man even more. He handed the identity jade tag back to Chu Qingyao and Chu Qingyu, and looked at Chu Shaoye and nodded with satisfaction.
He was able to deal with the loss of admission to Zhuyu College calmly, calmly and rationally, and without any jealousy. He was indeed a talent that could be made.
The inspector said: "Although I can't make an exception and give you an admission quota to Zhu Yu College, I have some connections in the Scarlet Sky Sect. I can write you a letter of introduction and let you become a handyman disciple in the Scarlet Sky Sect. Are you willing to go?"
The Chixiao Sect is a force adjacent to Zhu Yucheng. The two are of equal strength. Even for a handyman disciple, it is not that simple to join.
Chu Shaoye didn't expect that things would turn around. After being stunned for a while, he immediately agreed.
Although Chu Qingyao and Chu Qingyu had never heard of Chixiao Sect, since it was recommended by the inspector, it was naturally a good place to go. They swept away their disappointment and became happy for Chu Shaoye.
Now Brother Chu also has somewhere to go.
The mayor asked for paper and pen, and the inspector immediately wrote a letter of recommendation, printed his personal seal and handed it to Chu Shaoye.
Chu Shaoye took it with both hands and put the letter into his arms with great care.
ChuWangshan was very excited. He would not speak politely and could only express his gratitude to the inspector.
The inspector waved his hand. He was not completely selfless in doing this. In addition to appreciating Chu Shaoye, with the qualifications of Chu Qingyao and Chu Qingyu, as long as they don't die prematurely, they will achieve something in the future. This is also a good relationship for him in advance.
The mayor wanted to invite the inspector and several people from Chujia Village to a dinner, but the inspector was in a hurry to return to the Spirit Master Association, so he declined.
Before leaving, the inspector said: "The overall qualifications of the children in Qingwu Town this year are good, especially in Chujia Village. When I go back, I will explain the situation to Zhuyu College and see if I can give more places to Qingwu Town in the future."
The mayor was overjoyed and did not expect such a good thing to happen. He hurriedly thanked the inspector again and again.
After sending the inspector away, Chu Wangshan also declined the mayor's invitation. "I still have to take the children back to the village. The parents are waiting. I'm afraid they will worry if I go back late."
Although he is honest, he has also been the village chief for many years. He is not stupid. He knows why the mayor is so diligent. "Don't worry, mayor. My children and Qingyu are both good children and will not forget their roots."
With his words, the mayor felt relieved and personally sent the people from Chujia Village away from the town.
After bidding farewell to the mayor, Chu Wangshan took the children on a bullock cart. Only Chu Shaoye and the other three in their village had the qualifications to be spiritual masters. The other children were inevitably a little depressed in comparison.
Chu Wangshan chuckled and comforted, "There are tens of millions of people in this world, can anyone become a spiritual master? Look at me, the village chief. Although I have Rhubarb, Rhubarb usually helps me plow the fields and pull carts. My life is no different from everyone else in the village."
"Everyone has their own destiny. Your parents are waiting at home. We parents don't expect our children to be successful, as long as you are healthy and happy."
Chu Wangshan took out an oil paper bag from his arms and handed it to Chu Qingyao, "Yaoyao, go and give everyone a piece, one piece for each person."
This is the Baiyun cake he bought from the food stall when he took the time just now. He is still a child, so he can coax him out by eating something delicious.
Chu Qingyao opened the oil paper bag and found exactly eight yuan inside. She gave one piece to everyone, including her and Chu Shaoye.
Baiyun cake is made of white kidney beans as the main ingredient. After the white kidney beans are steamed, the bean skin is filtered with gauze. The filtered bean paste is mixed with an appropriate amount of honey to form a dough, and then placed in a mold to press and shape. The surface is decorated with white sesame seeds and it is ready.
Baiyun cake is soft and sweet, and melts in your mouth. Children in the village cannot easily eat such exquisite cakes, so they hold it carefully with their hands and eat it in small bites, for fear of wasting it.
The child's mood came and went quickly. After eating the pastries, his mood improved a lot. He also had a smile on his face and said congratulations to the three of them.
Three spiritual masters suddenly appeared in Chujia Village. As fellow villagers, they are proud of themselves. From now on, their Chujia Village will be great, and other villages will not envy them to death.
Is it difficult to cultivate mythical beasts? I have ten of them!
